question: Hyperpol conditioning + depol test spike count. Load-bearing: rebound excitability after hyperpolarization. H1 (slow K+) predicts 16-30 (K+ fully available suppresses but allows firing). H2 (slow Na) predicts 5-14 (Na inactivation reduces excitability more). Severity: if H1 is false and Na inactivation dominates, value would be 5-14.
